L'équipe de l'IA4R dirige Novartis Biomedical Research (BR) dans l'exploration et l'application de méthodologies avancées d'IA et de ML pour générer de nouvelles idées de découverte de médicaments, et pour accélérer et améliorer l'efficacité de la découverte de médicaments tout en se concentrant sur les besoins des patients. AI4R s'associe à des équipes de découverte de médicaments, élève le niveau d'expertise de l'IA dans l'ensemble de la recherche biomédicale (BR) et veille à ce que la science de l'IA continue de s'adapter à l'écosystème en évolution rapide des technologies de l'IA en connectant les leaders de l'IA dans les milieux universitaires et industriels. Il s'agit d'un rôle de chef de file pour le groupe Systèmes et échelles d'IA au sein de l'IA4R et sera chargé d'un leadership technique et de projet solide, d'évaluation critique et de déploiement spécialisé de plates-formes de calcul, de données, de modèle, de code et d'agent pour permettre rapidement l'adoption d'approches, d'algorithmes, de modèles et de flux de travail d'IA afin de maximiser l'impact sur les domaines clés de la recherche biomédicale qui pourraient conduire à la mise au point de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Description de l'emploi Entrer dans un rôle de leadership façonnant l'avenir de l'IA à l'échelle, où les systèmes d'agents de pointe et les plates-formes d'IA d'entreprise transforment la façon dont la recherche biomédicale est réalisée. En tant que directeur et chef de groupe (AI-Systems & Scale), vous piloterez la conception et le déploiement de systèmes d'IA de prochaine génération, ce qui permettra aux scientifiques d'exploiter de façon transparente les données, les modèles et les flux de travail intelligents pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments. Vous dirigerez des équipes d'ingénieurs hautement performantes, définirez des architectures évolutives et veillerez à ce que les solutions d'IA soient robustes, gouvernées et efficaces. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et diriger la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour les systèmes, plates-formes et architectures agentsables évolutives de l'IA dans toute la recherche.
• Des équipes multidisciplinaires de pointe et d'échelle fournissant des systèmes d'IA de qualité de production et des applications intelligentes.
• Établir des architectures de référence pour les systèmes d'agents, y compris l'orchestration, la récupération, la mémoire et les contrôles humains en boucle.
• Construire et normaliser des plateformes d'agents d'entreprise avec des composants réutilisables, des flux de travail et des cadres d'évaluation.
• Définir et faire respecter les opérations d'apprentissage automatique et les grandes normes d'exploitation des modèles linguistiques dans l'ensemble du développement des systèmes d'IA.
• Qualité de l'agent et ingénierie de la sécurité, y compris les garde-corps, l'application des politiques et les mécanismes de détection des défaillances.
• Conduire des stratégies de déploiement évolutives, assurant performances, fiabilité, rentabilité et architecture multi-locataires.
• Définir des paramètres de performance reliant l'efficacité du système aux résultats scientifiques, y compris la précision, la robustesse et l'efficience.
• S'associer avec des équipes de données, de sécurité et de plateforme pour assurer la gouvernance, la conformité et une utilisation responsable des données.
• Encourager la collaboration interfonctionnelle et la gestion de portefeuille pour prioriser les initiatives de systèmes d'IA à impact élevé et réduire les doubles emplois. Exigences essentielles
• Expérience démontrée menant des initiatives de développement des capacités d'apprentissage automatique dans plusieurs domaines et équipes de découverte de médicaments.
• Forte expérience d'application de l'apprentissage automatique dans des domaines fonctionnels tels que le calcul

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF142,100.00 - CHF263,900.00

Job Description Summary
LI#- Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

As a Therapeutic Area Biomarker Lead (TABL) in the Biomarker Development (BMD) group, you are accountable for defining and delivering biomarker strategies for the Immunology portfolio across multiple drug development programs in early and late clinical stages. You are accountable to translate the preclinical mechanistic understanding into an indication-relevant biomarker strategy, a clinical fit-for-purpose biomarker plan, oversee the integration into the clinical protocol, and lead the scientific and strategic discussions in project teams and governance meetings. As such you are a key member of global project teams, lead the Biomarker and Diagnostic teams, engage in Translational Data Science teams, and provide scientific, strategic, and tactical input aligned to the portfolio.

In the late phase particularly, you will be expected to assume the overall accountability for the biomarker strategy for at least one of our portfolio assets.

Furthermore, you will be leading overarching asset-related biomarker strategies enabling the delivery of late phase assets and respective launches.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• BMD scientific, strategic and tactical leader at project level driving impactful biomarker strategies and supporting biomarker plan excellence with concise communication in project teams and governance meetings.

• Accountable for the biomarker strategy at a project, indication and study level in coordination with the respective clinical study lead and biomarker study expert.

• Lead a dedicated matrixed group of biomarker subject matter experts and project team representatives to align key stakeholders on the biomarker strategy and biomarker plan at the project and study level and across the portfolio.

• Accountable for the concept, endorsement, implementation, delivery and contextualization of the biomarker strategy.

• Contextualizes biomarker results and disseminates conclusions to external audiences via abstracts and/or peer-reviewed publications.

• Co-leads strategic translational data science working groups focused on integrating large-scale molecular and clinical patient data sets to identify novel indications, patient subgroups, and endpoints to enable decision-making.

• Providing thought leadership with other BMD TABLs to identify synergies and drive innovation across our large and diverse clinical portfolio in immunology and general medicine.

• Representing BMD on early and late Disease Area Initiatives or Consortia to identify, develop, and drive disease and compound mechanistic biology, clinical decision-making exploratory biomarkers and precision medicine hypotheses for the portfolio.

• Implementing strategies in close collaboration with the BMD global organization which includes over 100 associates with expertise in all aspects of biomarker science i.e. genetics, genomics, molecular and cellular, digital devices, imaging and data sciences.

Essential Requirements:

• PhD degree in Life Sciences required

• Experience in industry (Pharma or Biotech) for at least 5+ years, working on Clinical Trials.

• Scientific excellence in immunological diseases in the translational and biomarker spaces.

• Relevant expertise utilizing biomarkers for clinical decision-making including pharmacodynamics, clinical efficacy, disease deconvolution, response characterization, patient stratification and/or precision medicine.

• Evidence of interpreting and disseminating omics related findings, e.g. genetics, genomics, proteomics, with relevant application to clinical decision making while partnering with key stakeholders from research, data sciences and clinical development.

• Scientific excellence supported by recognized high quality publications

• Experience performing similar role within a pharmaceutical/biotechnology research company, clinical research organization or academic medical cent

Gamma di insalata: CHF142,100.00 - CHF263,900.00 Descrizione del lavoro LI#- Hybrid Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera Come Area terapeutica Biomarker Lead (TABL) nel gruppo Biomarker Development (BMD), sei responsabile per la definizione e la fornitura di strategie di biomarcatore per il portafoglio di Immunology attraverso più programmi di sviluppo della droga nelle fasi cliniche iniziali e tardive. Siete responsabili di tradurre la comprensione meccanistica preclinica in una strategia di biomarcatore di riferimento, un piano clinico fit-for-purpose biomarker, supervisionare l'integrazione nel protocollo clinico, e condurre le discussioni scientifiche e strategiche in team di progetto e incontri di governance. In quanto tale sei un membro chiave dei team di progetto globali, guidare i team Biomarker e Diagnostic, impegnarsi in team di Translational Data Science e fornire input scientifici, strategici e tattici allineati al portafoglio. Nella fase avanzata, in particolare, si prevede di assumere la responsabilità generale per la strategia biomarcatrice per almeno uno dei nostri asset portafoglio. Inoltre, sarete leader overarching strategie di biomarcazione relative agli asset che permettono la consegna di attività di fase tardiva e rispettivi lanci. Descrizione del lavoro Responsabilità chiave:
• Leader scientifico, strategico e tattico di BMD a livello di progetto, guidando strategie di biomarcatore di impatto e sostenendo l'eccellenza del piano di biomarcatore con la comunicazione concisa in team di progetto e incontri di governance.
• Contabile per la strategia di biomarcatore a un livello di progetto, indicazione e studio in coordinamento con il rispettivo direttore di studio clinico e esperto di studi biomarcatori.
• Guidare un gruppo dedicato di esperti di materia biomarcatrice e rappresentanti del team di progetto per allineare i principali stakeholder sulla strategia di biomarcatore e il piano biomarcatore a livello di progetto e di studio e in tutto il portafoglio.
• Contabile per il concetto, l'approvazione, l'attuazione, la consegna e la contestualizzazione della strategia del biomarcatore.
• Contextualizza i risultati del biomarcatore e diffonde le conclusioni al pubblico esterno attraverso astratti e/o pubblicazioni peer-reviewed.
• Co-promuovere i gruppi di lavoro strategici di scienza dei dati traduttivi focalizzati sull'integrazione di dati molecolari e clinici su larga scala per identificare nuove indicazioni, sottogruppi dei pazienti e endpoint per consentire il processo decisionale.
• Fornire leadership di pensiero con altri TABL BMD per identificare sinergie e guidare l'innovazione attraverso il nostro ampio e diversificato portafoglio clinico in immunologia e medicina generale.
• Rappresentando BMD sulle Iniziative o Consorzi di Area Malattia precoce e tarda per identificare, sviluppare e guidare la malattia e la biologia meccanistica composta, biomarcatori esplorativi decisionali clinici e ipotesi di medicina di precisione per il portafoglio.
• Implementare strategie in stretta collaborazione con l'organizzazione globale BMD che comprende oltre 100 associati con competenze in tutti gli aspetti della scienza dei biomarcatori, cioè genetica, genomica, dispositivi molecolari e cellulari, digitali, immagini e scienze dei dati. Requisiti essenziali:
• Laurea in Scienze della vita necessaria
• Esperienza nell'industria (Pharma o Biotech) per almeno 5 anni, lavorando su processi clinici.
• Eccellenza scientifica nelle malattie immunologiche negli spazi traduttivi e biomarcatori.
• Competenze rilevanti utilizzando biomarcatori per il processo decisionale clinico tra cui la farmacodinamica, l'efficacia clinica, la deconvoluzione delle malattie, la caratterizzazione della risposta, la stratificazione del paziente e/o la medicina di precisione.
• Prove di interpretare e divulgare i risultati relativi omici, ad esempio genetica, genomica, proteomica, con applicazione rilevante al processo decisionale clinico, collaborando con i principali stakeholder della ricerca, delle scienze dei dati e dello sviluppo clinico.
• Eccellenza scientifica sostenuta da pubblicazioni di alta qualità riconosciute
• Esperienza che svolgono un ruolo simile all'interno di una società di ricerca farmaceutica / biotecnologia, organizzazione di ricerca clinica o centro medico accademico

• BMD wissenschaftlicher, strategischer und taktischer Leiter auf Projektebene treibt wirkungsvolle Biomarker-Strategien voran und unterstützt Biomarker-Plan-Exzellenz mit prägnanter Kommunikation in Projektteams und Governance-Meetings.
• Verantwortlich für die Biomarker-Strategie auf Projekt-, Indikations- und Studienebene in Abstimmung mit dem jeweiligen Studienleiter und Biomarker-Studienexperten.
• Führen Sie eine spezielle Matrixgruppe von Biomarker-Experten und Vertretern des Projektteams, um die wichtigsten Interessengruppen in Bezug auf die Biomarker-Strategie und den Biomarker-Plan auf Projekt- und Studienebene und im gesamten Portfolio abzustimmen.

• Kontextualisiert Biomarker-Ergebnisse und verbreitet Schlussfolgerungen über Abstracts und / oder Peer-Review-Publikationen an externe Zielgruppen.
• Co-Leiter strategischer translationaler Data Science Arbeitsgruppen, die sich auf die Integration groß angelegter molekularer und klinischer Patientendatensätze konzentrieren, um neuartige Indikationen, Patientenuntergruppen und Endpunkte zu identifizieren, um die Entscheidungsfindung zu ermöglichen.
• Vordenkerrolle mit anderen BMD TABLs, um Synergien zu identifizieren und Innovationen in unserem großen und vielfältigen klinischen Portfolio in Immunologie und Allgemeinmedizin voranzutreiben.

• PhD-Abschluss in Life Sciences erforderlich

Genetik, Genomik, Proteomik, mit relevanter Anwendung auf die klinische Entscheidungsfindung bei gleichzeitiger Partnerschaft mit wichtigen Interessengruppen aus Forschung, Datenwissenschaften und klinischer Entwicklung.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Échelle salariale : 142 100 CHF - 263 900,00 CHF Sommaire de la description d'emploi LI#- Hybride Lieu: Bâle, Suisse En tant que chef de biomarqueur du secteur thérapeutique (TABL) dans le groupe Développement des biomarqueurs (BMD), vous êtes responsable de la définition et de la prestation de stratégies de biomarqueur pour le portefeuille d'immunologie dans plusieurs programmes de développement de médicaments au début et à la fin des étapes cliniques. Vous êtes responsable de traduire la compréhension mécaniste préclinique en une stratégie de biomarqueur pertinente à l'indication, un plan de biomarqueur clinique adapté à l'usage, superviser l'intégration dans le protocole clinique et diriger les discussions scientifiques et stratégiques dans les équipes de projet et les réunions de gouvernance. À ce titre, vous êtes un membre clé des équipes de projet mondiales, dirigez les équipes de biomarqueur et de diagnostic, participez à des équipes de sciences des données translationnelles et fournissez des contributions scientifiques, stratégiques et tactiques alignées sur le portefeuille. Au cours de la dernière phase, particulièrement, vous devrez assumer la responsabilité globale de la stratégie de biomarqueur pour au moins un de nos actifs de portefeuille. De plus, vous dirigerez des stratégies globales de biomarqueurs liés aux actifs permettant la livraison d'actifs en phase tardive et de lancements respectifs. Description de l'emploi Principales responsabilités :
• Leader scientifique, stratégique et tactique de la DMO au niveau du projet, qui pilote des stratégies de biomarqueurs efficaces et soutient l'excellence du plan de biomarqueurs avec une communication concise au sein des équipes de projet et des réunions de gouvernance.
• Responsable de la stratégie du biomarqueur à un niveau de projet, d'indication et d'étude en coordination avec le chef de l'étude clinique et l'expert de l'étude du biomarqueur.
• Diriger un groupe d'experts en matière de biomarqueurs et de représentants de l'équipe de projet spécialement matricielle afin d'aligner les principaux intervenants sur la stratégie du biomarqueur et le plan du biomarqueur au niveau du projet et de l'étude et à l'échelle du portefeuille.
• Responsable du concept, de l'approbation, de la mise en oeuvre, de l'exécution et de la contextualisation de la stratégie de biomarqueur.
• Contextualise les résultats des biomarqueurs et diffuse les conclusions à des auditoires externes au moyen de résumés ou de publications évaluées par des pairs.
• Codirige des groupes de travail stratégiques sur les données translationnelles axés sur l'intégration d'ensembles de données moléculaires et cliniques à grande échelle sur les patients afin d'identifier de nouvelles indications, des sous-groupes de patients et des paramètres permettant de prendre des décisions.
• Fournir un leadership de réflexion avec d'autres BMD TABL pour identifier les synergies et stimuler l'innovation dans notre vaste et diversifié portefeuille clinique en immunologie et en médecine générale.
• Représentation de la DMO dans les initiatives ou les consortiums des régions de maladies précoces et tardives pour identifier, développer et stimuler la biologie mécanique des maladies et des composés, la prise de décisions cliniques biomarqueurs exploratoires et les hypothèses de médecine de précision pour le portefeuille.
• Mettre en oeuvre des stratégies en étroite collaboration avec l'organisation mondiale de la BMD, qui comprend plus de 100 associés ayant une expertise dans tous les aspects de la science biomarqueur, c'est-à-dire la génétique, la génomique, la moléculaire et cellulaire, les appareils numériques, l'imagerie et les sciences des données. Exigences essentielles:
• Doctorat en sciences de la vie requis
• Expérience dans l'industrie (Pharma ou Biotech) depuis au moins 5 ans, travaillant sur les essais cliniques.
• L'excellence scientifique des maladies immunologiques dans les espaces translationnels et biomarqueurs.
• Expertise pertinente utilisant des biomarqueurs pour la prise de décisions cliniques, y compris la pharmacodynamique, l'efficacité clinique, la déconvolution de la maladie, la caractérisation de la réponse, la stratification du patient et/ou la médecine de précision.
• Preuve de l'interprétation et de la diffusion des résultats liés à l'omique, p. ex. génétique, génomique, protéomique, avec application pertinente à la prise de décision clinique tout en collaborant avec des intervenants clés de la recherche, des sciences des données et du développement clinique.
• Excellence scientifique soutenue par des publications reconnues de haute qualité
• Expérience dans le cadre d'un rôle semblable au sein d'une entreprise de recherche pharmaceutique ou en biotechnologie, d'un organisme de recherche clinique ou d'un centre médical universitaire

Job Description Summary
#LI-Onsite

We are looking for a dedicated QC Analyst to support Good 'x' Practice (GxP) activities in our quality department. This role involves managing quality systems, implementing operational processes and ensuring compliance with Novartis quality standards.

This role is limited to 24 months.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Maintain compliance with current Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), GxP-compliant documentation, and records within the Novartis quality management system.

• Perform and evaluate analytical tasks in a pharmaceutical laboratory, including working in shifts where necessary.

• Ensure the integrity of all quality assurance records and data, as applicable, and foster collaboration between your team and other functions and departments.

• Ensure an appropriate level of education and GxP knowledge.

• Support quality audits and health authority inspections.

Essential Requirements:

• Experience in quality assurance and analytical skills.

• Proficiency in analytical technologies (e.g., HPLC, GC, titration).

• Knowledge in the use of lab-specific software (e.g., Empower, Chromeleon, TiAmo).

• GMP experience and technological expertise.

• Willingness to work in shifts.

• Fluency in German and English.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion / EEO: Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and accommodation: Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, be-cause of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Skills Desired
Collaboration, Communication Skills (Inactive), Data Integrity, Deadline Adherence, Digital saviness (Inactive), Health & Safety Regulations Knowledge (Inactive), Leadership, Managing Ambiguity, monitoring (Inactive), Problem Solving Skills (Inactive), Punctuality, Regulatory Requirements knowledge (Inactive)

#LI-Onsite

We are looking for a dedicated QC Analyst to support Good 'x' Practice (GxP) activities in our quality department. This role involves managing quality systems, implementing operational processes and ensuring compliance with Novartis quality standards.

This role is limited to 24 months.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Perform and evaluate analytical tasks in a pharmaceutical laboratory, including working in shifts where necessary.

• Ensure an appropriate level of education and GxP knowledge.

• GMP experience and technological expertise.

Job Description Summary
Job Title: Director & Group Head (Applied AI)
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Novartis has embraced a bold strategy to drive a company-wide digital transformation. Our objective is to position Novartis as an industry leader by proactively adopting digital technologies that foster innovative approaches to hasten drug discovery and development. By utilizing both internal and external R&D data with the power of data science, predictive models, generative AI, and machine learning, our objective is to identify new targets, create more effective therapeutic molecules, better predict drug pharmacokinetics and safety risks, refine clinical trial design, and significantly shorten development cycles. The AI4R team leads BR in exploring and applying advanced AI and ML methodologies to generate novel drug discovery insights, and to speed and improve drug discovery efficiency whilst focusing on patients’ needs.

AI4R partners with drug discovery teams, raises the level of AI expertise across Biomedical Research (BR) and ensures that BR science keeps up with the rapidly evolving ecosystem of AI technologies by connecting with AI leaders in academia and industry.

This leadership role for the  Applied AI group of AI4R will be tasked with strong technical, team and project leadership, aligning with biomedical subject matter experts to deeply understand ML opportunities in drug discovery, assessment of the model landscape, leading model benchmarking, and applying the right AI approaches, algorithms, models and workflows to maximize impact on key domains areas of biomedical research that will potentially lead to developing better drugs, faster.

Job Description
Step into a pivotal leadership role at the forefront of scientific innovation, where cutting-edge artificial intelligence meets biomedical research. As Director & Group Head (Applied AI), you will shape how advanced machine learning approaches accelerate drug discovery, translating complex data into meaningful scientific insights that can transform patient outcomes. You will lead high-impact collaborations, guide strategic AI direction across research domains, and empower teams to push the boundaries of what is possible in developing better medicines, faster.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and lead the applied artificial intelligence strategy and multi-year roadmap across drug discovery research.

• Align priorities with portfolio needs, scientific opportunities, and measurable business and research impact.

• Lead multidisciplinary teams to identify, prototype, benchmark, and deploy fit-for-purpose artificial intelligence solutions.

• Govern an applied artificial intelligence portfolio with clear intake, prioritization, resourcing, delivery oversight, and success metrics.

• Establish best practices for problem framing, data readiness, benchmarking, evaluation design, and reproducible model development.

• Drive benchmarking of foundation and task-specific models, enabling transparent trade-offs and informed adoption decisions.

• Partner with engineering teams to scale solutions and embed them into day-to-day scientific decision making.

• Define rigorous evaluation metrics linking model performance to downstream decisions and experimental outcomes.

• Build a culture of scientific rigor, rapid iteration, mentorship, and practical impact across teams.

• Forge strategic academic and industry collaborations to accelerate innovation, benchmarking, and technology transfer.

Essential Requirements

• Demonstrated experience in leading core machine learning capability development initiatives across drug discovery teams and use cases.

• Proven experience with foundation model benchmarking in drug discovery applications.

• Hands-on experience applying machine learning

Il nostro obiettivo è quello di posizionare Novartis come leader del settore adottando proattivamente tecnologie digitali che favoriscono approcci innovativi per accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Utilizzando dati R&D interni ed esterni con la potenza della scienza dei dati, modelli predittivi, AI generativo e machine learning, il nostro obiettivo è quello di identificare nuovi obiettivi, creare molecole terapeutiche più efficaci, prevedere meglio farmacocinetica e rischi di sicurezza, perfezionare il design di prova clinica e ridurre significativamente i cicli di sviluppo. Il team AI4R conduce BR nell'esplorazione e nell'applicazione di metodologie AI e ML avanzate per generare nuove intuizioni di scoperta della droga, e per accelerare e migliorare l'efficienza della scoperta della droga, concentrandosi sulle esigenze dei pazienti. I partner AI4R con i team di scoperta della droga, aumentano il livello di esperienza AI in Biomedical Research (BR) e assicurano che la scienza BR continui con l'ecosistema in rapida evoluzione delle tecnologie AI collegandosi con i leader dell'IA in accademia e industria. Questo ruolo di leadership per il gruppo AI Applicato di AI4R sarà affidato a una forte leadership tecnica, di squadra e di progetto, allineando con gli esperti di materia biomedica per comprendere profondamente le opportunità ML nella scoperta della droga, valutazione del paesaggio del modello, benchmarking del modello di leader, e applicando i giusti approcci AI, algoritmi, modelli e flussi di lavoro per massimizzare l'impatto sulle aree chiave di ricerca biomedica che potenzialmente porteranno a sviluppare farmaci migliori, più velocemente. Descrizione del lavoro Entra in un ruolo di leadership fondamentale all'avanguardia nell'innovazione scientifica, dove l'intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia incontra la ricerca biomedica. In qualità di Direttore & Group Head (Applied AI), formerai come approcci avanzati di machine learning accelerano la scoperta dei farmaci, traducendo dati complessi in approfondimenti scientifici significativi che possono trasformare i risultati dei pazienti. Potrai condurre collaborazioni ad alto impatto, guidare la direzione strategica AI attraverso i domini di ricerca, e rafforzare i team di spingere i confini di ciò che è possibile nello sviluppo di farmaci migliori, più veloce. Principali responsabilità
• Definire e guidare la strategia di intelligenza artificiale applicata e roadmap pluriennale attraverso la ricerca di scoperta della droga.
• Allineare le priorità con le esigenze del portafoglio, le opportunità scientifiche e l'impatto commerciale e di ricerca misurabile.
• Leader team multidisciplinari per identificare, prototipo, benchmark e distribuire soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale fit-for-purpose.
• Governare un portafoglio di intelligenza artificiale applicato con l'assunzione chiara, la priorità, la risonanza, la supervisione della consegna e le metriche di successo.
• Stabilire le migliori pratiche per la definizione dei problemi, la disponibilità dei dati, il benchmarking, la progettazione della valutazione e lo sviluppo del modello riproducibile.
• Promuovere il benchmarking delle fondazioni e dei modelli specifici per le attività, consentendo scambi trasparenti e decisioni di adozione informate.
• Collaborare con i team di ingegneria per scalare le soluzioni e incorporarle nel processo decisionale scientifico quotidiano.
• Definire metriche di valutazione rigorose che collegano le prestazioni del modello a decisioni a valle e risultati sperimentali.
• Costruire una cultura del rigore scientifico, rapida iterazione, mentorship e impatto pratico tra le squadre.
• Forge collaborazioni accademiche e industriali strategiche per accelerare innovazione, benchmarking e trasferimento tecnologico. Requisiti essenziali
• Esperienza dimostrata nelle principali iniziative di sviluppo delle capacità di apprendimento delle macchine principali tra i team di scoperta della droga e casi di utilizzo.
• Esperienza dimostrata con il modello di base benchmarking nelle applicazioni di scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza pratica sull'applicazione dell'apprendimento automatico

Das AI4R-Team leitet BR bei der Erforschung und Anwendung fortschrittlicher KI- und ML-Methoden, um neue Erkenntnisse in der Wirkstoffforschung zu generieren und die Effizienz der Wirkstoffforschung zu beschleunigen und zu verbessern, während es sich auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten konzentriert. AI4R arbeitet mit Wirkstoffforschungsteams zusammen, erhöht das Niveau der KI-Expertise in der biomedizinischen Forschung (BR) und stellt sicher, dass die BR-Wissenschaft mit dem sich schnell entwickelnden Ökosystem der KI-Technologien Schritt hält, indem sie sich mit KI-Führungskräften in Wissenschaft und Industrie verbindet. Échelle salariale : 1 46 300,00 CHF - 2 71 700,00 CHF Résumé de la description d'emploi Titre du poste: Directeur et chef de groupe (IA appliquée) #LI-Hybrid Lieu: Bâle, Suisse Soutien à la réinstallation: Ce rôle est basé à Bâle, en Suisse. Novartis n'est pas en mesure d'offrir une aide à la réinstallation : veuillez soumettre une demande seulement si elle est accessible. Novartis a adopté une stratégie audacieuse pour conduire une transformation numérique à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Notre objectif est de positionner Novartis comme un leader de l'industrie en adoptant proactivement des technologies numériques qui favorisent des approches novatrices pour accélérer la découverte et le développement de médicaments. En utilisant les données internes et externes de R-D avec la puissance de la science des données, des modèles prédictifs, de l'IA générative et de l'apprentissage machine, notre objectif est d'identifier de nouvelles cibles, de créer des molécules thérapeutiques plus efficaces, de mieux prédire la pharmacocinétique des médicaments et les risques pour la sécurité, d'affiner la conception des essais cliniques et de raccourcir considérablement les cycles de développement. L'équipe de l'IA4R dirige BR dans l'exploration et l'application de méthodologies avancées d'IA et de ML pour générer de nouvelles idées de découverte de médicaments, et pour accélérer et améliorer l'efficacité de la découverte de médicaments tout en se concentrant sur les besoins des patients. L'IA4R s'associe à des équipes de découverte de médicaments, augmente le niveau d'expertise de l'IA dans l'ensemble de la recherche biomédicale (BR) et veille à ce que la science de l'IA continue de s'adapter à l'écosystème en évolution rapide des technologies de l'IA en se connectant aux leaders de l'IA dans les milieux universitaires et industriels. Ce rôle de chef de file pour le groupe AI4R appliqué sera chargé d'assurer un solide leadership technique, d'équipe et de projet, en s' alignant avec les experts en matière biomédicale pour bien comprendre les possibilités de ML dans la découverte de médicaments, l'évaluation du paysage du modèle, l'analyse comparative des modèles et l'application des approches, algorithmes, modèles et flux de travail appropriés en matière d'IA afin de maximiser l'impact sur les domaines clés de la recherche biomédicale qui pourraient mener à la mise au point de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Description de l'emploi Entrez dans un rôle de leadership central à l'avant-garde de l'innovation scientifique, où l'intelligence artificielle de pointe rencontre la recherche biomédicale. En tant que directeur et chef de groupe (IA appliquée), vous déterminerez comment l'apprentissage automatique avancé s'approche pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments, transformant des données complexes en données scientifiques significatives qui peuvent transformer les résultats des patients. Vous dirigerez des collaborations à impact élevé, guiderez l'orientation stratégique de l'IA dans tous les domaines de recherche et permettreez aux équipes de repousser les limites de ce qui est possible pour développer de meilleurs médicaments, plus rapidement. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et diriger la stratégie d'intelligence artificielle appliquée et la feuille de route pluriannuelle pour la recherche sur la découverte de médicaments.
• Harmoniser les priorités avec les besoins du portefeuille, les possibilités scientifiques et l'impact mesurable des activités et de la recherche.
• Diriger des équipes multidisciplinaires pour identifier, prototyper, comparer et déployer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle adaptées à l'usage.
• Gouvernance d'un portefeuille de renseignements artificiels appliqués comportant des données d'entrée, de priorité, de ressourcement, de surveillance de l'exécution et de mesure du succès.
• Établir des pratiques exemplaires pour l'élaboration des problèmes, la préparation aux données, l'analyse comparative, la conception de l'évaluation et l'élaboration de modèles reproductibles.
• Diriger l'analyse comparative des modèles de base et des modèles spécifiques aux tâches, en permettant des compromis transparents et des décisions d'adoption éclairées.
• Partenaire avec des équipes d'ingénierie pour mettre à l'échelle les solutions et les intégrer dans la prise de décision scientifique quotidienne.
• Définir des mesures d'évaluation rigoureuses reliant le rendement du modèle aux décisions en aval et aux résultats expérimentaux.
• Construire une culture de rigueur scientifique, d'itération rapide, de mentorat et d'impact pratique entre les équipes.
• Forger des collaborations stratégiques entre les universités et l'industrie pour accélérer l'innovation, l'étalonnage et le transfert de technologie. Exigences essentielles
• Expérience démontrée dans la conduite d'initiatives de développement de la capacité d'apprentissage automatique au sein des équipes de découverte de médicaments et des cas d'utilisation.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'analyse comparative des modèles de base dans les applications de découverte de médicaments.
• Expérience pratique en appliquant l'apprentissage automatique

Job Description Summary
The Senior Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer will join the Modeling & Simulation Data Science team within the Translational Medicine Unit to help advance data-driven drug discovery. The role is focused on transforming large-scale ADME, PK, and related experimental datasets into actionable insights through advanced analytics, machine learning, and robust software engineering. Partnering closely with pharmacokinetic sciences (PKS) scientists, Data & Digital teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, this position will drive the development of scalable analytical applications, reusable computational workflows, and decision-enabling in silico solutions that accelerate lead optimization and strengthen scientific decision making.

Job Description
200+ experimental datasets are generated every day in the Pharmacokinetic Sciences (PKS) department at Novartis Biomedical Research. This role sits at the center of efforts to unlock the value of these data for decision making and to shape the future of medicine through advanced data science.
As Associate Director Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer, you will join the Modeling & Simulation Data Science team in the Translational Medicine Unit and work at the intersection of data science, software engineering, and drug discovery. You will apply machine learning, statistics, and modern software development practices to harness ADME and PK data, uncover structure–property relationships, and translate scientific and business needs into scalable, strategically aligned solutions.
You will collaborate closely with Data & Digital and PKS wet- (ADME and bioanalytical) and dry-lab (modeling) teams to identify opportunities where data, applications, and in silico methods can meaningfully improve decision quality, efficiency, and scientific impact. In addition to hands-on technical delivery, you will help shape and champion fit-for-purpose solutions that are robust, reusable, and maintainable in a production setting.
This role is ideal for a scientifically grounded data leader who combines strong analytical depth with practical software engineering expertise, and who is motivated by delivering measurable impact in drug discovery through high-quality data products, machine learning, and computational innovation.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as a key Modeling & Simulation Data Science representative on discovery and lead optimization programs, contributing scientific and strategic input to project discussions and decisions.

• Partner with Data & Digital and PKS wet- and dry-lab teams to identify priority gaps, clarify business needs, and translate them into high-impact analytical and computational solutions.

• Design, build, and maintain scalable applications, workflows, and data pipelines that support scientific analysis and decision making across projects and modalities.

• Develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning and statistical models to uncover relationships between chemical structure and molecular or pharmacokinetic properties.

• Apply data mining, visualization, and exploratory analysis to derive insight from complex experimental datasets and communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.

• Create and implement project- or modality-specific in silico models and data strategies that accelerate and streamline compound progression decisions.

• Write production-quality code following strong software engineering practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and maintainability standards.

• Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives spanning data science, software engineering, and laboratory teams, ensuring delivery of fit-for-purpose solutions.

• Promote the adoption and effective use of in-house tools, applications, and data science methods to maximize impact across Translational Medicine and PKS.

• Stay current with advances in AI/ML, statistics, and computational

Questo ruolo si trova al centro degli sforzi per sbloccare il valore di questi dati per il processo decisionale e per modellare il futuro della medicina attraverso la scienza dei dati avanzata. Come Direttore associato Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer, si unirà al team di Modeling & Simulation Data Science nell'unità di Medicina Traduttiva e lavorare all'intersezione di scienza dei dati, ingegneria del software e scoperta della droga. Si applicherà l'apprendimento automatico, le statistiche e le pratiche di sviluppo software moderne per sfruttare i dati ADME e PK, scoprire le relazioni struttura-proprietà, e tradurre le esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in soluzioni scalabili, strategicamente allineate. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team Data & Digital e PKS bagnato- (ADME e bioanalitico) e Dry-lab (modello) per identificare le opportunità in cui dati, applicazioni e metodi silico possono migliorare significativamente la qualità delle decisioni, l'efficienza e l'impatto scientifico. Oltre alla consegna tecnica pratica, vi aiuterà a modellare e campione soluzioni fit-for-purpose che sono robuste, riutilizzabili e manutenbili in un ambiente di produzione. Questo ruolo è ideale per un leader di dati scientificamente fondato che combina una forte profondità analitica con competenze pratiche di ingegneria del software, e che è motivato da fornire un impatto misurabile nella scoperta della droga attraverso prodotti di dati di alta qualità, machine learning e innovazione computazionale. Principali responsabilità
• Atto come un rappresentante chiave della Modeling & Simulation Data Science sulla scoperta e sui programmi di ottimizzazione dei lead, contribuendo all'ingresso scientifico e strategico per le discussioni e le decisioni del progetto.
• Partner con i team Data & Digital e PKS bagnati e a secco per identificare lacune prioritarie, chiarire le esigenze aziendali e tradurli in soluzioni analitiche e computazionali ad alto impatto.
• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di applicazioni scalabili, flussi di lavoro e datadotti che supportano l'analisi scientifica e il processo decisionale in progetti e modalità.
• Sviluppare, valutare e distribuire modelli di machine learning e statistici per scoprire le relazioni tra struttura chimica e proprietà molecolari o farmacocinetiche.
• Applicare l'estrazione dati, la visualizzazione e l'analisi esplorativa per ricavare informazioni da complessi dataset sperimentali e comunicare risultati chiaramente a diversi stakeholder.
• Creare e implementare progetti o modalità specifiche in modelli silico e strategie di dati che accelerano e razionalizzano le decisioni di progressione dei composti.
• Scrivere codice di qualità della produzione seguendo forti pratiche di ingegneria del software, tra cui il controllo della versione, test, documentazione e standard di manutenbilità.
• Condurre o contribuire a iniziative interfunzionali che coinvolgono la scienza dei dati, l'ingegneria del software e i team di laboratorio, garantendo la fornitura di soluzioni fit-for-purpose.
• Promuovere l'adozione e l'uso efficace di strumenti interni, applicazioni e metodi di scienza dei dati per massimizzare l'impatto su Medicina Traduttiva e PKS.
• Soggiorna corrente con progressi in AI/ML, statistiche e computazionali

Job Description Summary
The Senior Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer will join the Modeling & Simulation Data Science team within the Translational Medicine Unit to help advance data-driven drug discovery. The role is focused on transforming large-scale ADME, PK, and related experimental datasets into actionable insights through advanced analytics, machine learning, and robust software engineering. Partnering closely with pharmacokinetic sciences (PKS) scientists, Data & Digital teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, this position will drive the development of scalable analytical applications, reusable computational workflows, and decision-enabling in silico solutions that accelerate lead optimization and strengthen scientific decision making.

Job Description
200+ experimental datasets are generated every day in the Pharmacokinetic Sciences (PKS) department at Novartis Biomedical Research. This role sits at the center of efforts to unlock the value of these data for decision making and to shape the future of medicine through advanced data science.
As Associate Director Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer, you will join the Modeling & Simulation Data Science team in the Translational Medicine Unit and work at the intersection of data science, software engineering, and drug discovery. You will apply machine learning, statistics, and modern software development practices to harness ADME and PK data, uncover structure–property relationships, and translate scientific and business needs into scalable, strategically aligned solutions.
You will collaborate closely with Data & Digital and PKS wet- (ADME and bioanalytical) and dry-lab (modeling) teams to identify opportunities where data, applications, and in silico methods can meaningfully improve decision quality, efficiency, and scientific impact. In addition to hands-on technical delivery, you will help shape and champion fit-for-purpose solutions that are robust, reusable, and maintainable in a production setting.
This role is ideal for a scientifically grounded data leader who combines strong analytical depth with practical software engineering expertise, and who is motivated by delivering measurable impact in drug discovery through high-quality data products, machine learning, and computational innovation.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as a key Modeling & Simulation Data Science representative on discovery and lead optimization programs, contributing scientific and strategic input to project discussions and decisions.

• Partner with Data & Digital and PKS wet- and dry-lab teams to identify priority gaps, clarify business needs, and translate them into high-impact analytical and computational solutions.

• Design, build, and maintain scalable applications, workflows, and data pipelines that support scientific analysis and decision making across projects and modalities.

• Develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning and statistical models to uncover relationships between chemical structure and molecular or pharmacokinetic properties.

• Apply data mining, visualization, and exploratory analysis to derive insight from complex experimental datasets and communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.

• Create and implement project- or modality-specific in silico models and data strategies that accelerate and streamline compound progression decisions.

• Write production-quality code following strong software engineering practices, including version control, testing, documentation, and maintainability standards.

• Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives spanning data science, software engineering, and laboratory teams, ensuring delivery of fit-for-purpose solutions.

• Promote the adoption and effective use of in-house tools, applications, and data science methods to maximize impact across Translational Medicine and PKS.

• Stay current with advances in AI/ML, statistics, and computational

Échelle salariale : CHF 102,200,00 - CHF 189 800,00 Résumé de la description d'emploi Le chercheur principal en données et ingénieur en logiciels scientifiques se joindra à l'équipe de modélisation et de simulation des données scientifiques au sein de l'Unité de médecine translationnelle pour aider à faire avancer la découverte de médicaments axée sur les données. Le rôle consiste principalement à transformer les ensembles de données ADME, PK et les ensembles de données expérimentaux connexes en données exploitables grâce à des analyses avancées, à l'apprentissage automatique et à une ingénierie logicielle robuste. En étroite collaboration avec les scientifiques en sciences pharmacocinétiques (SCP), les équipes Data & Digital et les intervenants interfonctionnels, ce poste permettra de développer des applications analytiques évolutives, des flux de travail informatiques réutilisables et des solutions silico qui accélèrent l'optimisation du plomb et renforcent la prise de décision scientifique. Description de l'emploi 200 ensembles de données expérimentales sont générés chaque jour dans le département des sciences pharmacocinétiques (PKS) de Novartis Biomedical Research. Ce rôle est au centre des efforts visant à débloquer la valeur de ces données pour la prise de décision et à façonner l'avenir de la médecine grâce à la science avancée des données. En tant que directeur associé Data Scientist & Scientific Software Engineer, vous vous joignez à l'équipe de modélisation et de simulation Data Science de l'Unité de médecine translationnelle et travaillerez à l'intersection de la science des données, du génie logiciel et de la découverte de médicaments. Vous appliquerez l'apprentissage automatique, les statistiques et les pratiques modernes de développement de logiciels pour exploiter les données ADME et PK, découvrir les relations structure-propriété et traduire les besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en solutions évolutives et alignées stratégiquement. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de Data & Digital et PKS wet- (ADME et bioanalytique) et de labyrinthe sèche (modélisation) pour identifier les possibilités où les données, les applications et les méthodes de silico peuvent améliorer significativement la qualité de décision, l'efficacité et l'impact scientifique. En plus de la livraison technique pratique, vous aiderez à façonner et à promouvoir des solutions adaptées à l'usage qui sont robustes, réutilisables et durables dans un cadre de production. Ce rôle est idéal pour un leader scientifique des données qui combine une forte profondeur d'analyse avec une expertise pratique en génie logiciel, et qui est motivé par un impact mesurable dans la découverte de médicaments grâce à des produits de données de haute qualité, l'apprentissage automatique et l'innovation informatique. Principales responsabilités
• Agir en tant que représentant clé de la modélisation et de la simulation des données sur les programmes d'optimisation des découvertes et des chefs de file, en fournissant des contributions scientifiques et stratégiques aux discussions et aux décisions relatives aux projets.
• Faites équipe avec Data & Digital et PKS pour identifier les lacunes prioritaires, clarifier les besoins des entreprises et les traduire en solutions analytiques et informatiques à impact élevé.
• Concevoir, construire et maintenir des applications évolutives, des flux de travail et des pipelines de données qui appuient l'analyse scientifique et la prise de décisions à travers les projets et les modalités.
• Élaborer, évaluer et déployer des modèles d'apprentissage machine et de statistique pour découvrir les relations entre la structure chimique et les propriétés moléculaires ou pharmacocinétiques.
• Appliquer l'extraction de données, la visualisation et l'analyse exploratoire pour obtenir des données expérimentales complexes et communiquer clairement les résultats aux divers intervenants.
• Créer et mettre en œuvre des modèles de silico et des stratégies de données propres à chaque projet ou modalité, qui accélèrent et rationalisent les décisions de progression complexe.
• Écrire un code de qualité de production en suivant de solides pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle, y compris le contrôle des versions, les essais, la documentation et les normes de maintenance.
• Diriger ou contribuer à des initiatives interfonctionnelles touchant les données scientifiques, le génie logiciel et les équipes de laboratoire, en assurant la prestation de solutions adaptées à l'usage.
• Promouvoir l'adoption et l'utilisation efficace d'outils, d'applications et de méthodes de science des données internes pour maximiser l'impact de la médecine translationnelle et de la SP.
• Restez à jour avec les avancées en AI/ML, les statistiques et les calculs

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Step into a pivotal role where your leadership can directly shape how breakthrough cardiovascular innovations reach patients worldwide.

International Value & Access Director - Cardio Pipeline, you will set a bold strategic direction, transforming scientific advances into clear, compelling value for payers and healthcare systems. You’ll inspire and unite cross‑functional and country teams, championing access solutions that accelerate affordability, broaden impact, and redefine what’s possible for patients and health systems.

Here, your vision, influence, and enterprise mindset will help build an integrated access strategy that truly moves the needle — for Novartis, for partners, and most importantly, for the people we serve.

This position reports into the Executive Director, V&A CRM.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Lead creation and execution of integrated international access strategies across the full development‑to‑commercial continuum.

• Shape compelling payer and healthcare‑system value propositions grounded in strong scientific and access‑relevant evidence.

• Represent Access internally and externally, influencing strategic discussions and strengthening Novartis’ international access agenda.

• Embed access insights into Target Product Profiles, clinical plans, and integrated evidence plans to guide asset decision‑making.

• Partner with Commercial Launch Strategy, Pricing, and Therapeutic Areas to co‑create robust international pricing strategies and guidance.

• Ensure timely, high‑quality access input into Integrated Product Strategy, business development assessments, and indication sequencing.

• Collaborate with Health Economics and cross‑franchise teams to align evidence priorities with key market needs.

• Anticipate shifts in priority markets and health‑technology‑assessment archetypes to model future access assumptions and recommendations.

• Build strong cross‑functional and external partnerships to enable innovative, scalable access solutions.

• Champion an enterprise approach, connecting countries and functions to deliver consistent, high‑impact access strategies.

Essential Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience in market access roles, including 2+ years global or ex-US regional experience.

• CRM product launch experience.

• 2+ years of experience in the relevant therapeutic area.

• Cross functional leadership experience across matrix organization.

• Strong communication skills and ability to influence across a range of diverse stakeholders to drive change.

• Competitive and entrepreneurial mindset with proven track record of fostering innovation.

Desirable Requirements:

• 7+ years of experience in market access roles, including 5+ years global or ex-US regional experience.

• Strong external network with thought leaders and influencers in the payer and HTA environment.

Novartis cannot offer relocation support – please only apply if the location is easily accessible to you. Shift work – 6/4 shift model Do you want to actively contribute to making life-changing medicines reliable and of the highest quality? As an equipment operator at Novartis, you are an integral part of our production team and contribute every day to ensuring that our products are produced safely, on time and to the highest quality standards. If you would like to work practically, take responsibility and be part of a dedicated team in a dynamic environment, we look forward to your application. Job description Main tasks:
• Implementation of manufacturing activities in accordance with production plan and quality specifications
• Careful and timely testing of batch documentation
• Cleaning, preparation and disinfection of production facilities and premises
• Performing of sampling, aliquotations and in-process controls
• Monitoring of plant function and early detection of deviations
• Reporting incidents and anomalies to competent departments
• Compliance with quality, safety and environmental regulations in everyday production Minimum requirements:
• Experience in a chemical or pharmaceutical environment or training, ideally as a chemical and pharmatechnologist
• Very good understanding of Good Manufacturing Practice is mandatory
• Technical understanding and ability to work independently and reliably according to specifications
• Experience with process control systems, ideally DeltaV (Emerson) or Siemens control systems
• Careful, structured and quality-conscious working method with high personal responsibility
• Negotiating knowledge of German and basic English Desirable requirements:
• Safe handling of Microsoft Office and process control systems Benefits & Services Read our guide to find out how we can help you develop personally and professionally: https://www.novartis.com/careers/benefits-rewards Our commitment to diversity, equal treatment and inclusion Novartis is committed to an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams that reflect the patients and communities we serve. Accessibility and support in the application process: If you need special assistance during the recruitment process due to illness or disability and/or want more detailed information about the key functions of the position, please send an email to diversity.inclusion ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please do not forget to include the reference number of the vacancy notice. Why Novartis: Supporting people with diseases and their families requires more than innovative science. Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

What if the deals you shape today could define the future of healthcare? As Head BD&L Transactions, Immunology, you’ll be at the heart of Novartis’ growth engine—leading high-impact partnerships that bring transformative therapies to patients worldwide. From early research to commercialization, you’ll architect and negotiate complex, global deals, working at the intersection of science, strategy, and business. This is a rare opportunity to influence our immunology pipeline, collaborate with senior leaders, and position Novartis as a partner of choice across the industry.

Job Description

Als Head BD & L Transactions, Immunology, stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt des Wachstumsmotors von Novartis - führende Partnerschaften mit hoher Wirkung, die Patienten weltweit transformative Therapien anbieten. Von der frühen Forschung bis zur Kommerzialisierung werden Sie komplexe, globale Geschäfte entwerfen und verhandeln und an der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Strategie und Geschäft arbeiten. Dies ist eine seltene Gelegenheit, unsere Immunologie-Pipeline zu beeinflussen, mit leitenden Führungskräften zusammenzuarbeiten und Novartis als bevorzugten Partner in der gesamten Branche zu positionieren. Stellenbeschreibung Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Erstellen und Aushandeln komplexer Lizenz- und Partnertransaktionen in allen Entwicklungsphasen
• Deal-Strukturierung, Term Sheet-Entwicklung und Vertragsverhandlungen mit externen Partnern vorantreiben
• Orchestrieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams, um starke, datengesteuerte Geschäftsfälle zu erstellen
• Enge Partnerschaft mit der Führung des Therapeutic Area zur Ausrichtung auf Strategie und Prioritäten
• Navigieren Sie durch Governance-Prozesse und präsentieren Sie klare Empfehlungen für leitende Entscheidungsträger
• Verwalten Sie interne und externe Stakeholder, um Transaktionen effizient und wettbewerbsfähig voranzutreiben
• Überwachung der externen Landschaft, Ermittlung von Partnermöglichkeiten und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten
• Stärkung und Nutzung eines umfangreichen Branchennetzwerks zur Erschließung hochwertiger Kooperationen
• Champion Novartis als Partner der Wahl durch wirkungsvolle Interaktionen und Transaktionsausführung Grundlegende Anforderungen
• PhD in Science, ideal kombiniert mit einem Master of Business Administration oder gleichwertig
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Business Development, Lizenzierung oder Investment Banking in der Pharmaindustrie
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei Beschaffung, Strukturierung, Verhandlung und Abschluss komplexer Partnerschaftsabkommen
• Tiefes Verständnis der Arzneimittelentwicklung über Forschungs-, Entwicklungs- und Vermarktungsstufen hinweg
• Starke Führungserfahrung im Management globaler, funktionsübergreifender Teams und strategischer Initiativen

Die Belohnungen, Teil unseres Teams zu sein, gehen weit über Grundlohn und Anreize hinaus. Wir bieten auch eine Vielzahl von Wettbewerbsvorteilen an, die Ihnen helfen, persönlich und professionell zu gedeihen, wie Versicherungspläne, Altersvorsorgepläne, Wohlbefindensressourcen und globale Anerkennungsprogramme. Darüber hinaus bieten wir flexible und hybride Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, wo möglich, und mindestens 14 Wochen bezahlten Elternurlaub. Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt haben Sie möglicherweise Anspruch auf einen leistungsbezogenen Bonus, der von bestimmten Leistungsparametern abhängt. Langfristige Aktienprämien, die auf Gruppenebene gewährt werden, können ebenfalls Teil Ihres Pakets sein. Weitere Details werden während des Bewerbungsprozesses angegeben. Lesen Sie unsere Broschüre, um mehr über unser globales Gesamtprämienangebot zu erfahren: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf Hinweis: Leistungen und Entschädigungen können von Land zu Land variieren und unterliegen lokalen gesetzlichen Anforderungen, einschließlich der Bestimmungen von Tarifverträgen, sofern anwendbar. Location: Basel, Switzerland or Cambridge, United States (see separate posting)

Ready to shape the future of innovation at Novartis? As a Patent Attorney, you will play a pivotal role in protecting groundbreaking scientific discoveries and enabling life-changing medicines to reach patients worldwide. Partnering closely with R&D teams, you will drive strategic intellectual property decisions, build robust patent portfolios, and navigate complex legal landscapes to safeguard innovation across the product lifecycle.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Provide clear, strategic, and business-focused counsel to Novartis R&D clients on invention protection, portfolio development, publication strategy, and third-party risks.

• Build and manage patent portfolios for Novartis R&D projects by identifying inventions and preparing, prosecuting, maintaining, and defending patent filings across areas such as new molecular entities, processes, manufacturing, platforms, technologies, and clinical developments.

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Build and manage relationships with outside counsel and collaborators, including extensive interaction within a multicultural global patent function.

• Conduct due diligence and provide counsel based on those assessments, including freedom-to-operate, infringement, validity, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Provide IP support for transactional matters, including M&A, research collaborations, and in-licensing opportunities, with advice on contract drafting and negotiation

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Significant experience as a patent attorney within a law firm or pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

• Expertise in U.S. and PCT patent law, filing processes, and prosecution practice, with a detailed understanding of European patent law and other major global patent systems

• Proven ability to partner with scientific and business stakeholders to deliver strategic intellectual property advice

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with high attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, global environment

• Render legal opinions on patentability, validity, and freedom to operate, and develop patent strategies that strengthen IP positions, support freedom to operate, and enable effective IP defense.

• Apply deep knowledge of national patent law and practice, including relevant legal developments and patent trends, to shape strategy and advice.

• Understand and apply other forms of exclusivity protection, as appropriate.

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and leaders across the legal, IP, and R&D organizations.

• Build and manage relationships with outside counsel and collaborators, including extensive interaction within a multicultural global patent function.

• Conduct due diligence and provide counsel based on those assessments, including freedom-to-operate, infringement, validity, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation strategies.

• Provide IP support for transactional matters, including M&A, research collaborations, and in-licensing opportunities, with advice on contract drafting and negotiation

• Ensure high-quality, timely delivery of work aligned with business goals and budgets

Essential Requirements

• University degree in law, admission to the bar and qualification as a European Patent Attorney / Lawyer

• Advanced degree in chemistry or related field, with strong preference for a doctoral degree

• Significant experience as a patent attorney within a law firm or pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

• Strong technical expertise in chemistry, preferably including experience with small molecules, synthesis, or pharmaceutical development.

• Expertise in U.S. and PCT patent law, filing processes, and prosecution practice, with a detailed understanding of European patent law and other major global patent systems

• Proven ability to partner with scientific and business stakeholders to deliver strategic intellectual property advice

• Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills with high attention to detail

• Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced, global environment

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 146.300 - CHF 271.700

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

Job Description Summary
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.

Job Description
The Strategy, Platforms & Transformation t eam is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We work within the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. This role is crucial in driving AI transformation by bringing the best in AI and tech to unlock opportunities for growth and improve patient outcomes.

The Executive Director, AI Foundations Engineering Lead will lead the engineering strategy, delivery, and operational excellence for the organization’s agentic AI operating system, with responsibility spanning solution architecture, development, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be central to enabling the transformation of existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by providing a scalable, secure, and high performing foundation. The ideal candidate will bring deep engineering leadership, systems thinking, and technical vision to guide the design and evolution of core agentic capabilities, establish engineering standards and operating models, and lead cross functional teams in delivering resilient and extensible AI services. Working closely with product leaders, business stakeholders, data and technology teams, and transformation leaders, this role will ensure the agentic systems accelerate innovation, support enterprise adoption, and delivers measurable business value through reliable and scalable execution.

Major Accountabilities:

• Define and lead the engineering strategy, roadmap, and operating model for our organization’s agentic AI platform.

• Oversee the design, development, integration, deployment, and ongoing operation of foundational capabilities that support agentic AI products and workflows.

• Establish platform engineering standards, architectural principles, and development practices to ensure scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.

• Lead cross functional engineering teams in building reusable platform services, tools, and components that accelerate product delivery and adoption.

• Partner with product, data, infrastructure, security, and business teams to align platform capabilities with enterprise priorities and evolving user needs.

• Drive platform performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement through monitoring, feedback loops, incident review, and service optimization.

• Guide the modernization of existing systems and processes to enable integration with agentic AI products, workflows, and platform services.

• Communicate agentic AI strategy, technical direction, delivery progress, risks, and investment needs to senior executives and key stakeholders.

Essential Requirements:

• A minimum of a bachelor's degree in related field is required; Master of Science and/or MBA strongly preferred

• 15 plus years of progressive product management experience, including significant leadership over senior product leaders, with a strong track record of defining and scaling enterprise level product strategy and execution.

• Deep expertise in AI driven product management, including experience bringing innovative data, machine learning, and generative AI products from concept to commercialization in complex enterprise environments.

• Proven people leadership and organizational development capability, with experience leading directors and senior product teams, building high performing organizations, and establishing effective product operating models and governance.

• Strong cross functional and executive influence skills, with demonstrated suc

jobs.description:
Salary Range:
CHF126,000.00 - CHF234,000.00

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland
This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

We are a global team of highly skilled analytical project managers with presence in all biologics technical research and development sites of Novartis in Europe, and we are looking for you as an experienced, curious, inspiring Analytical Project Leader to join our team in Basel to support development of biologic products.

Job Description
Your Key Responsibilities:

• You are responsible for the overall analytical project strategy including robust and phase-dependent control strategy to support technical development of highly innovative biologic products.

• You will lead and coordinate the analytical sub-team in a matrix organization and represent the analytic discipline in the global CMC project team of assigned projects.

• You are accountable for managing all analytic related activities of drug product and drug substance development including release and stability testing, molecule characterization, method- development, -transfer and -validation, specification setting, know-how transfer etc.

• You will lead and coordinate timely delivery of high quality source documents for submission, review of regulatory documents and interact with Heath Authorities in audits and scientific advice meetings

• You will need to communicate effectively across organizational interfaces i.e. project-management, line functions, senior management, etc.

• You will proactively identify scientific, technological and GMP issues, propose creative solutions and communicate key issues to the appropriate management level

• You are responsible for high quality analytical registration documents for HA submissions and interact with authorities, act as technical expert in audits, inspections etc.

• You are responsible for analytical budget and resource planning

Minimum requirements :

• PhD and minimum of 8 years relevant experience of Biologics CMC development or University life-science degree with appropriate industry experience

• Excellent theoretical and profound scientific knowledge in analytical areas in biologic drug development

• Strong scientific leadership, bringing innovative molecules from research to development.

• Excellent understanding of regulatory expectations and requirements with significant experience with IND/ BLA submission

• Strong experience in leading matrix teams and strong communication skills

• Proficiency in English

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 126,000.00 - 234,000.00 CHF

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #
Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera
Questo ruolo ha sede a Basilea, in Svizzera. Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento per questo ruolo. Si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile per voi.

Siamo un team globale di direttori di progetti analitici altamente qualificati con presenza in tutti i siti di ricerca e sviluppo tecnico biologici di Novartis in Europa, e ti stiamo cercando come un esperto, curioso, ispiratore Leader di progetto analitico per unirsi al nostro team di Basilea per sostenere lo sviluppo di prodotti biologici.

Descrizione del lavoro
Le tue responsabilità chiave:

• Sei responsabile della strategia globale di progetto analitico, compresa la strategia di controllo robusta e dipendente dalla fase per supportare lo sviluppo tecnico di prodotti biologici altamente innovativi.

• Potrai guidare e coordinare il sub-team analitico in un'organizzazione di matrice e rappresentare la disciplina analitica nel team di progetto CMC globale di progetti assegnati.

• Siete responsabili per la gestione di tutte le attività correlate analitiche di sviluppo del prodotto della droga e della sostanza della droga, tra cui il rilascio e il test di stabilità, la caratterizzazione delle molecole, lo sviluppo dei metodi, -transfer e -validation, impostazione delle specifiche, trasferimento di know-how ecc.

• Potrai condurre e coordinare la consegna tempestiva di documenti di alta qualità fonte per la presentazione, la revisione dei documenti normativi e interagire con le autorità di Heath in audit e incontri di consulenza scientifica

• Sarà necessario comunicare efficacemente attraverso interfacce organizzative cioè project-management, funzioni di linea, senior management, ecc.

• Identificare proattivamente le questioni scientifiche, tecnologiche e GMP, proporre soluzioni creative e comunicare le questioni chiave al livello di gestione appropriato

• Sei responsabile di documenti di registrazione analitica di alta qualità per le presentazioni HA e interagire con le autorità, agire come esperto tecnico in audit, ispezioni ecc.

• Sei responsabile del bilancio analitico e della pianificazione delle risorse

Requisiti minimi:

• PhD e minimo 8 anni di esperienza rilevante di Biologics CMC sviluppo o laurea in scienze della vita universitaria con un'adeguata esperienza nel settore

• Eccellente conoscenza teorica e profonda scientifica nelle aree analitiche nello sviluppo di farmaci biologici

• Forte leadership scientifica, portando molecole innovative dalla ricerca allo sviluppo.

• Ottima comprensione delle aspettative e dei requisiti normativi con esperienza significativa con la presentazione IND/ BLA

• Esperienza forte nei principali team di matrice e forti capacità di comunicazione

• Proficienza in inglese

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: 126,000.00 - 234,000.00 CHF

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come competenze rilevanti, competenze ed esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

Leggi la nostra brochure per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di premi totali:

https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Nota: i benefici e i risarcimenti possono variare per paese e sono soggetti a requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni di contratti collettivi, ove applicabile. Una panoramica completa del vostro pacchetto di compensazione, compreso qualsiasi

Wir sind ein globales Team von hochqualifizierten analytischen Projektmanagern mit Präsenz in allen technischen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsstandorten von Biologics in Europa und suchen Sie als erfahrenen, neugierigen und inspirierenden analytischen Projektleiter, der sich unserem Team in Basel anschließt, um die Entwicklung biologischer Produkte zu unterstützen.

Ihre wichtigsten Aufgaben:
